ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَبْغِيَ أَوْ يُبْغَى عَلَيَّ ، اَوْ أَطْغَى أَوْ يُطْغَى عَلَيَّ .
tr: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bi ka min an aẓlima, aw uẓlama, aw abghiya aw yubghā `alayya, aw aṭghā aw yuṭghā `alayya.
en: O Allah, I surely seek refuge with you lest I oppress or get oppressed, infringe or am infringed upon, or terrorise or am terrorised!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالشِّرْكِ الظَّاهِرِ وَالْخَفِيِّ، وَالظُّلْمِ وَالْجَوْرِ مِنِّي وَعَلَيَّ .
tr: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bi ka min ‘sh-shakki wa ‘sh-shirki ‘ẓ-ẓāhiri wa ‘l-khafiyyi, Wa ẓ-ẓulmi wa ‘l-jawri minnī wa `alayya.
en: O Allah, I surely seek refuge with you from doubt, polytheism apparent or latent, oppression, and injustice from me or to me!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْكَ فِيْ عِيَاذٍ مَنِيْعٍ وَحِرْزٍ حَصِيْنٍ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ، حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنِيْ أَجَلِيْ مُعَافًى مِنْ كُلِّ بَلِيَّةٍ فِيْ دِيْنِيْ ، وَدُنْيَايَ ، وَبَدَنِيْ ، وَ أَهْلِيْ، وَأَصْحَابِيْ ، وَأَحْبَابِيْ ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ .
tr: Allāhumma ‘j`alnī min ka fī `iyādhin manī`in wa ḥirzin ḥaṣīnin min jamī`i khalqika, Ḥattā tuballighanī ajalī mu`āfan min kulli baliyyatin fī Dīnī, Wa Dunyāya, Wa badanī, wa ahlī, Wa aṣhābī, Wa aḥbābī, Yā Rabba ‘l-Ālamīn.
en: O Allah, place me, from You in an impenetrable refuge and protective fortress from all of Your creation, until my time comes, exempted from every distress in my religion, worldly life, body, family, companions and loved ones, O Lord of the Worlds!
